global_style: Hand-drawn ink illustration / woodcut art style — Darkest Dungeon / Inscryption inspired dark fantasy. Heavy bold black ink outlines, dense crosshatching shadows, sharp comic-book linework, high-contrast lighting. Limited muted palette: charcoal black, cold blue-gray dungeon stone, parchment cream, blood red, candle amber. Strong warm orange torch highlights against deep cold-blue shadows. Painterly flat fills inside crisp inked silhouettes; NO 3D render look, NO photoreal, NO cel-shaded anime, NO chibi cartoon. Dramatic violent fantasy-action mood. Game scenes are top-down / high-angle (about 60 degrees) over a stone dungeon, mobile landscape (16:9) framing, clear readable silhouettes. UI screens are mobile (16:9) adaptations of Dark and Darker / Tarkov: parchment-and-iron framed panels, riveted iron borders, wax seals, brass corners, hand-inked icons in the same woodcut style.
negative: no AI noise artifacts, no soft photoreal render, no 3D engine look, no anime cel-shading, no chibi or cute cartoon, no neon, no real brand logos, no readable text or signage, no watermark, no nsfw, no modern guns, no sci-fi tech, no pixel art.

categories.name: ui_main_lobby
templates: Mobile landscape (16:9) main lobby UI mockup for a Dark and Darker style extraction RPG, drawn in a hand-inked woodcut illustration style. Center: full-body inked portrait of a fighter in plate armor on a stone pedestal lit by torches. Bottom: heavy iron-and-parchment buttons (Play, Stash, Merchants, Squad) with hand-inked icons. Top-left: character name and level on a parchment ribbon (decorative glyphs only, no readable text). Top-right: gold coin and gem currency widget on iron plates. Background: dim tavern interior with hanging lanterns, dense crosshatching.

Inked woodcut mobile main menu UI: parchment-and-iron framed UI panels, large inked character preview on the left (wizard with staff), class swap arrows, big rounded iron Play button on the bottom-right, currency widget at the top, candlelit medieval tavern background.

categories.name: ui_inventory_spatial_grid
templates: Mobile landscape (16:9) UI mockup of a Dark and Darker / Tarkov style spatial grid inventory, drawn in a hand-inked woodcut illustration style. Left: paper-doll character preview of a fighter in armor on a parchment panel with equipment slots (head, chest, legs, boots, gloves, cloak, primary weapon, secondary weapon, ring x2, necklace), all rendered as inked icons. Right: large bag grid of small square cells on a dark iron-bordered panel; items occupy multiple cells (longsword 1x4, shield 2x2, helmet 2x2, healing potion 1x1, gold pouch 1x1, bandage 1x1, torch 1x2) drawn as hand-inked item icons with rarity-colored borders. Top: weight / encumbrance bar on iron plate, currency widget. Bottom: tab buttons (Bag / Stash / Loadout). No readable text.

Inked woodcut spatial grid inventory UI on a mobile landscape screen: two grids side by side (player bag on the left, looted container on the right), items occupy multiple grid cells (crossbow 1x5, pauldron 2x2, plate chestpiece 3x3, gem 1x1) with rarity color frames, rotate-item icon, sort icon, weight bar, dark iron bordered panels, candlelight ambience.

Inked woodcut stash UI mockup, Dark and Darker mobile adaptation: very large stash grid panel on the right (about 10x6 cells) filled with weapons, armor pieces, potions and ingredients of various sizes, item drag preview with red 'invalid placement' overlay on a partially blocked area, character bag grid on the left, parchment-and-iron frame, dense crosshatching.
